sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE SPRAWLING UPPER RIDGE OVER THE CENTRAL STATES WILL BEGIN TO WEAKEN AND SHIFT SLOWLY EWD AS A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH EJECTS ENEWD FROM THE INTERIOR PAC NW TO MY/ERN MT BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. AT THE SURFACE...LEE CYCLOGENESIS IS EXPECTED LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS IN ADVANCE OF THE EJECTING UPPER TROUGH...AS A DOWNSTREAM WARM FRONT MOVES NWD ACROSS ND. THE FRONTAL ZONE WILL EXTEND SEWD ACROSS MN TO NRN IL/INDIANA/OH AND PA. THIS FRONTAL ZONE WILL PROVIDE A PRIMARY FOCUS FOR STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT TODAY INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY REGION TODAY
sections.text: A PERSISTENT MCS/SUPERCELL CLUSTER IS MOVING SEWD INVOF MSP AS OF 16Z. IT APPEARS THIS CONVECTION WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WHILE CONTINUING SEWD /WITH SEPARATE STORM DEVELOPMENT ALSO POSSIBLE/ ALONG THE FRONT/INSTABILITY GRADIENT ALIGNED ALONG THE MS RIVER...TOWARD SW WI/EXTREME NE IA/NRN IL. THE 12Z SOUNDINGS FROM MPX AND DVN SHOWED A RELATIVELY WEAK CAP THAT WILL DIMINISH AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES APPROACH 90 F...AND EXTREME INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE AOA 6000 J/KG. VERTICAL SHEAR WEAKENS WITH SEWD EXTENT...THUS THE INITIAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES MAY TRANSITION TO MORE OF AN OUTFLOW DOMINATED BOWING MCS INTO THE AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED WITH THE SUPERCELL CLUSTER...WHILE THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT WILL INCREASE SOME BY EARLY-MID AFTERNOON IF UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A BOWING CLUSTER OCCURS IN THE EXTREMELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT.

sections.title: OH VALLEY/MID ATLANTIC THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: WEAKENING THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE MOVING SWD ACROSS ERN KY/SRN WV. THIS CONVECTION HAS TEMPORARILY STABILIZED SRN OH/WV WITH OUTFLOW...WHILE DOWNSTREAM ANVIL DEBRIS CLOUDS ARE SLOWING SURFACE HEATING SOME INTO VA. THERE WILL BE SOME POTENTIAL FOR RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE SW FLANK OF THESE CLUSTERS AS SURFACE HEATING/DESTABILIZATION CONTINUE TO THE S AND W. FARTHER N AND E...DESTABILIZATION WILL CONTINUE IN CLOUD BREAKS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ALONG THE SYNOPTIC FRONT ACROSS INDIANA/OH/PA TO THE MID ATLANTIC...THOUGH PERSISTENT LOW CLOUDS SUGGEST THAT INSTABILITY WILL BE TEMPERED SOMEWHAT FROM CENTRAL OH EWD INTO WRN PA. NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON ALONG RESIDUAL MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES...THE WEAK FRONT...AND OVER THE LOCALLY HIGHER TERRAIN. THE COMBINATION OF MODERATE INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J PER KG/ AND 25-35 KT NLY DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT A FEW ORGANIZED MULTICELLS AND MARGINAL SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES/NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: ASCENT DOWNSTREAM FROM THE EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ALONG THE COLD FRONT WILL SUPPORT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN NRN ID NEWD INTO WRN/CENTRAL MT. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY WILL REMAIN SOMEWHAT LIMITED...THOUGH SURFACE HEATING/MIXING WILL RESULT IN PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR HIGH-BASED THUNDERSTORMS. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL ALSO INCREASE WITH THE APPROACH OF THE UPPER TROUGH...RESULTING IN AN ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. MUCH STRONGER INSTABILITY WILL BE FOCUSED ALONG THE WARM FRONT INTO ND THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. A STRONG CAP WILL TEND TO LIMIT THE PROSPECTS FOR SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS ND UNTIL LATE AFTERNOON...WHEN DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE AT LEAST MARGINALLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS. LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY STORMS THAT DO FORM THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING GIVEN THE CONTINUED PRESENCE OF EXTREME INSTABILITY...AND THERE WILL BE SOME POTENTIAL FOR EVENING STORMS TO PERSIST INTO TONIGHT WILL SPREADING EWD/SEWD TOWARD NW MN ON THE NOSE OF A STRENGTHENING LLJ. OTHERWISE...CONVECTION CO
